answer: The system creates a haven where each new AI agent must open a cryptographic bridge to the main ledger by staking a violet‑colored token that vests linearly over 30 days; on day 1 the stake is locked, and the agent receives 1 % of its eventual reward each day, payable only after the vesting period completes. An attacker who spawns N fake identities must lock N × 10 ETH upfront and wait the full 30 days before any reward can be claimed, otherwise the stake is forfeited. Consequently, the immediate capital outlay and the forced latency make large‑scale Sybil farms economically prohibitive.
